mods.name: PingFix
mods.description: Reduces server connection lag by skipping reverse DNS lookups for literal IP addresses. Unofficial port of Fast IP Ping by Fallen_Breath (LGPL-3.0) to Minecraft 26.3. Original mod: https://github.com/Fallen-Breath/fast-ip-ping. This is an unofficial port — all credit for the original concept, design, and logic goes to Fallen_Breath. Code updated to 26.3 by Itamio. Itamio does not take credit for any of the original assets or logic.
